about_the_game:
Can you save the world?

Overcome the threat of demons and become the legendary samurai "Mochiko"!

A fierce battle that will take the world by storm begins now.

"STORY"

It was at the birthday party of twin sisters, the emperor's children, who turned 18 years old...

Suddenly, a terrifying cult attacked and cursed them.

The twin sisters were turned into half demons, the party fell into chaos,

and the world was thrown into chaos.

The only one who can stand up is you - Mochiko.

With your honed sword skills and magic, can you save the emperor's children who have turned half demons,

and destroy the evil plot?

An ending that you can never predict awaits you.

Early Access This game is not perfect.

Defeat the demons and listen carefully to the important message!

"Game Contents"

- A fusion of swordsmanship and magic → Dodge attacks and defeat your enemies in style!

- Adventures in other worlds → A variety of stages await you!

- Deadly battles with powerful enemies → Monsters, skeletons, evil warriors, and fearsome demons

... Plan your strategy and grab victory!

- Discover hidden secrets → Explore dungeons and find rare items and hidden stories!

- Clear THE DOJO OF MOCHIKO to get a powerful sword!

THE DOJO OF MOCHIKO

[Biggest Features]

▼ Original sound × A luxurious cast of voice actors!

* Japanese anime voice actors bring the characters to life!

* The magnificent original soundtrack further enhances the heat of the story!

▼ Beautiful character designs by talented Japanese illustrators and 3D artists!

* Starting with the dignified figure of the female samurai Mochiko, allies and enemies are beautifully illustrated by talented illustrators!

short_description: This sword was forged to sever the past. As Mochiko, a lone female samurai, battle demons and powerful bosses across many worlds. Behind their rage lies a sorrowful truth. Handcrafted by a solo developer, this small indie game carries the weight of every slash—and a story that stays with you.
